text:
shipit-bot: Production deploy starting now (wave 1). env=production, tag=v3.6.0, commit=`4f7e3ad`. Change window 23:00-23:15 UTC. Rolling to 10% traffic. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/v3.6.0. Triggered by @maya.k :rocket:

maya.k: Ack — watching canary dashboards. I've enabled the canary smoke set and the synthetic checkout.

alex.z: Pinning DB migration spike flag OFF for first 5m. If error_rate > 1.5% or p95 > 500ms we rollback.

sre-dave: Oncall awake, tracing and verbose logs turned on for this wave. I'll mute noisy alerts and correlate traces.

shipit-bot: Canary at 10% -> health checks pass. metrics: error_rate=0.2%, p95=118ms (+8ms). Advancing to 50%.

maya.k: Nice. Gradual increase. Starting synthetic heavy-read load now.

shipit-bot: 50% traffic -> telemetry stable. error_rate=0.3%, p95=130ms. Moving to 100%.

alex.z: Saw a small GC bump on a pod but it recovered <5s. Noted.

shipit-bot: 100% rollout complete. tag=v3.6.0 commit=`4f7e3ad`. All regions reporting healthy. Duration 6m 12s. :white_check_mark:

maya.k: Thanks everyone. I'll kick off the post-deploy smoke suite and the feature-flag ramp tomorrow.

oncall-bot: Reminder: detailed trace retention increased to 1h for post-mortem if needed.

sre-dave: Marking this release pinned for 24h. Will watch nightly batch job runs and alert if regressions show up.
